purpose: Measure an exact decision-only early return after the complete confirming probe

real_selection.known_property: both cases established a decision after probe 2 in the prior application profile
real_selection.interpretation: positive-path cost diagnostic only; not an unbiased sensitivity or prevalence sample

constructed_controls.purpose: exercise the complete no-result schedule without treating recorded quiet visits as physical negatives

measurement.timed_boundary: detect function only on preformed immutable complex64 dual-RX dwell; serialization, IQ loading, hashing, and diagnostics excluded
measurement.diagnostic: one untimed candidate call records acquisition and scored-candidate counts

gates: every warmup, timed call, control call, and diagnostic DwellDetection exactly equals its oracle response
candidate completes both receivers and all candidates of its confirming probe
each recorded positive-path case must achieve at least 3.0x median process-CPU speedup; both rates must pass for promotion
negative-control speed is report-only and has no acceptance threshold
source lock and frozen-manifest IQ hashes match before execution
limitations: The outcome-informed real cases measure the earliest possible confirmation path and cannot estimate average traffic speedup.
All-zero controls validate a constructed no-result path, not absence of a physical signal.
This is saved-IQ server analysis, not deployment, RF, ARM, or full-response analysis evidence.
